subject: c-cont
title: C.CONT.------INFO.DE.(B)
description: Diagram closing BK(NM)-5. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'it might be more useful to simply examine the cross-transfer implications of information exchange.' The crossing diagrams how composite-continuance structurally meets information degrees at the cross-transfer-of-information-exchange scale: C-CONT (composite continuance — the form's actual continuance working) crossed with INFO-DE(B) (information degrees, or information degree basis). C-CONT sits at top-center with the subject-arrow; AF-NT (affinity nature) branches from the main line to the top-right, with VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) branching from AF-NT. T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) branches from the main line to the right, with EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) branching from it and SCI-DY (scientific dynamics) from EXP-DY; INFO-CON (information convergence) also branches from T-C-IMP, with POL-IMP (political implications) branching from INFO-CON and EXT-FT (extended functionalism) labelled at the same dot as INFO-CON. AFI (affinity insight) branches from the main line at lower-left, with RT-DY (reality dynamics) branching from AFI and HI-P (high purpose) at upper-left attached to RT-DY. INFO-DE(B) sits at center-bottom as partner-axis terminus.
